rules.description: no providerAthleteId — the row could never be joined to a box score
ruled Out by the injury feed at the forecast instant
ANY injury designation, including Day-To-Day — an unresolved status is withheld (founder rule)
minutes basis "insufficient", or fewer than 3 appearances used (the minutes model's MIN_GAMES_FOR_RATES)
expected minutes absent (never read as zero)
availability not read from an injury feed ("unknown" or absent) — unknown is not active
conditional-on-playing quantiles with playRate below 0.95 (or no playRate recorded)
per-minute rates not from the player's own history (team-pool fallback, or an unknown basis)
expected minutes below 20 (the preregistered graded population)
minutesSd / expectedMinutes above 0.35, or no measured minutes spread
the category's frozen distribution (mean, p10, p50, p90) is incomplete

ranking.rule: per board: continuous quantile summaries → frozen p50 desc, then mean desc, then providerAthleteId asc; whole-number (discrete) summaries on every candidate → frozen mean desc, then providerAthleteId asc (deterministic, no clock)

market.note: no NBA odds authorization exists; no line, odds, edge or over/under probability is ever recorded
